digest.component_or_area: Copilot agent skills registration and CI linting
propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops skills with descriptions exceeding 1024 characters or containing unquoted colons in YAML frontmatter without error or warning
rebar-implement (1327-char), rebar-janitor (1068-char), and rebar-debug (868-char with unquoted colon) fail to register due to frontmatter violations
Adding a deterministic CI lint in scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py will catch invalid SKILL.md frontmatters at commit time and prevent future regressions
SKILL.md descriptions must be converted to YAML folded block scalars and trimmed to ≤1024 characters while preserving skill invocation triggers
The lint check must validate YAML parseability, description presence/length, and name format (64-char max, alphanumeric-hyphen regex) for all tracked skills
